changelog:
* **feat: auto keyboard on notes dialog** (d3b4ed4)
  - Focus the notes field and raise the keyboard when the dialog opens.
  - Convert notes dialog to a custom Dialog so outside taps are caught.
  - Show Discard note confirmation on back press or outside tap.
  - Re-focus and raise the keyboard again after Keep editing.
  - Discard clears the typed note and closes the dialog.
* **fix: clear all survives process kill** (b0ac56a)
  - Extract shared persistNow helper from flushDraft.
  - Persist working sheet synchronously after every quantity update.
  - Persist the empty sheet on clear all so kills cannot restore it.
  - Keep ON_STOP flush as a harmless backstop write.
